Health Functional FoodCopper 0.8mgMagnesium 225mgManganese 2.25mgVitamin D 10μgVitamin K 70μgZinc 8.5mgCalcium 450mg2 times a day

제너럴밸런스 칼슘마그네슘Copper · Magnesium · Manganese · Vitamin D · Vitamin K · Zinc · Calcium

Made by 제너럴바이오 주식회사 · 2 times a day · 2 tablets

This product combines 0.8mg of Copper, 225mg of Magnesium, 2.25mg of Manganese, 10μg of Vitamin D, 70μg of Vitamin K, 8.5mg of Zinc, 450mg of Calcium as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • 2 times a day (2 tablets): 0.8mg Copper, 225mg Magnesium, 2.25mg Manganese, 10μg Vitamin D, 70μg Vitamin K, 8.5mg Zinc, 450mg Calcium
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 제너럴바이오 주식회사

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Copper
    • Needed for the transport and utilisation of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Magnesium
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
    • Needed for energy utilisation
  • Manganese
    • Needed for energy utilisation
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for bone formation
  • Vitamin D
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
  • Vitamin K
    • Needed for normal blood clotting
    • Needed for the structure of bone
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Calcium
    • Needed for the formation of bones and teeth
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
    • Needed for normal blood clotting
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

2 times a day2 tablets per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Copper labelled (0.8mg / 2400mg), 80~150%
Magnesium labelled (225mg / 2400mg), 80~150%
Manganese labelled (2.25mg / 2400mg), 80~150%
Vitamin D labelled (10μg / 2400mg), 80~180%
Vitamin K labelled (70μg / 2400mg), 80~180%
Zinc labelled (8.5mg / 2400mg), 80~150%
Calcium labelled (450mg / 2400mg), 80~150%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미∙이취가 없는 회황색의 장방형 제피정제
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월까지
Storage 직사광선을 피하고 서늘하고 건조한 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Copper · Magnesium · Manganese · Vitamin D · Vitamin K · Zinc · Calcium together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

source.mainFunction:
1) 비타민D : 칼슘과 인이 흡수되고 이용되는데 필요, 뼈의 형성과 유지에 필요, 골다공증발생 위험 감소에 도움을 줌.
2) 비타민K : 정상적인 혈액응고에 필요, 뼈의 구성에 필요.
3) 칼슘 : 뼈와 치아 형성에 필요, 신경과 근육 기능 유지에 필요, 정상적인 혈액응고에 필요, 골다공증발생 위험 감소에 도움을 줌.
4) 마그네슘 : 에너지 이용에 필요, 신경과 근육 기능 유지에 필요.
5) 아연 : 정상적인 면역기능에 필요, 정상적인 세포분열에 필요.
6) 구리 : 철의 운반과 이용에 필요, 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요.
7) 망간 : 뼈 형성에 필요, 에너지 이용에 필요, 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요.

  • Once a day (2 tablets): 0.264mg Copper, 260mg Magnesium, 0.99mg Manganese, 10μg Vitamin D, 100μg Vitamin K, 2.805mg Zinc, 520mg Calcium
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 코스맥스바이오(주)

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Copper
    • Needed for the transport and utilisation of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Magnesium
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
    • Needed for energy utilisation
  • Manganese
    • Needed for energy utilisation
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for bone formation
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin K
    • Needed for normal blood clotting
    • Needed for the structure of bone
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Calcium
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
    • Needed for normal blood clotting
    • Needed for the formation of bones and teeth
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
